title: Associator equation for the canonical flat single tensorators
statement: Let B be a symmetric closed monoidal Grothendieck abelian coefficient category with additive tensor and functorial flat resolutions, X a scheme, and L,M,N sheaves on its small etale site, with L and M flat. Write S for degree-zero inclusion, μ(A,C)=singleFunctorObjTensorIso(A,C).hom when A is flat, and α for the specified ordinary or derived associator. The tensor L tensor M is flat. Then (μ(L,M) tensor 1);μ(L tensor M,N);S(α(L,M,N))=α(SL,SM,SN);(1 tensor μ(M,N));μ(L,M tensor N). No arbitrary pairing maps occur and N need not be flat. The notions are those of [def-kun-derived-tensor], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules].

source.place: Tags 06YQ (lemma-bounded-flat-K-flat) and 06YU (definition-derived-tor and signed symmetry immediately following it); degree-zero specialization of the canonical tensor localization.

proof.text: Use the explicitly constructed strong monoidal structure on degree-zero cochain complexes, whose tensorator is the prescribed single/total-tensor comparison.

Compose the comparison with the strong monoidal homotopy quotient and the lax monoidal localization Qh. Their associativity equations transport the cochain equation to the derived category. Cancel the intermediate natural single/quotient comparisons. Expand the resulting tensorators to singleFunctorObjTensorIso.hom, using flatness of L, M, and L tensor M.

proof_origin.place: Canonical single-complex specialization of the tensor localization and its functorial comparison; expanded into the component argument above.

lean.statement:
theorem singleFunctorObjTensorIso_associativity
    (L M N : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology B)
    (hL : ObjectProperty.flat L) (hM : ObjectProperty.flat M) :
    (singleFunctorObjTensorIso L M hL).hom ▷
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj N) ≫
      (singleFunctorObjTensorIso (L ⊗ M) N (ObjectProperty.prop_tensor hL hM)).hom ≫
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).map (α_ L M N).hom =
    (derivedTensorAssociator B X _ _ _).hom ≫
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj L ◁
        (singleFunctorObjTensorIso M N hM).hom ≫
      (singleFunctorObjTensorIso L (M ⊗ N) hL).hom
